CorrosionProtection.subpoint1_title: Specialized Repair, Restoration & Protection for Wind Turbine Components
CorrosionProtection.point1_body: RODOPI’s Wind Maintenance & Repair services cover every critical component of a wind turbine. Our teams perform visual, drone-based, and lightning protection system inspections—both on the ground and via rope access. We specialize in GFRP (glass fiber reinforced plastic) repairs using epoxy or polyester, covering everything from blade cracks and bonding issues to nacelle and hub structure restoration. In addition, we install performance-enhancing components like vortex generators and sensors. On the tower side, we handle dent repairs, vibration mitigation, and high-grade anti-corrosion coatings. Our electrical and mechanical experts work on heating systems, retrofits, brake pads, generators, winches, lifts, pumps, and lubrication systems. With RODOPI, you get holistic maintenance with a focus on energy output and turbine longevity.

rodopi-ccs-partnership.title: RODOPI Announced as European Distribution & Service Partner for Carmel Corrosion Systems (CCS)
rodopi-ccs-partnership.author: Press Release

content.text: RODOPI is excited to announce its new role as the European distribution and service partner for Carmel Corrosion Systems (CCS), a leader in corrosion protection technology. This partnership aims to establish CCS’s advanced corrosion protection solutions across Europe.

CCS Wrap is an innovative, wrap-around corrosion protection system designed for easy on-site installation. It provides robust protection against corrosion for risers, subsea pipelines, jetty piles, and structures in splash zones both offshore and in deep-water locations.

“We are happy to partner with Carmel Corrosion Systems to introduce their innovative corrosion protection solutions to the European market. This collaboration perfectly aligns with our commitment to sustainability and excellence in infrastructure protection,“ said Ercan Kara Osman, Managing Director at RODOPI.

Manufactured in Vermont, USA, CCS wraps comply with U.S. and International Standards (ISO 9001:2008 certified). Each wrap is serialized, and all materials are fully traceable to ensure high quality and performance.

Annual inspections show CCS wraps significantly reduce corrosion rates, maintaining metal integrity even after 10 years. Key benefits include quick installation, UV stability, abrasion resistance, custom fit, and a 10-year warranty.
The wraps are available in various configurations, including:

items: HD 4 Ply Wrap with easy one-piece installation and corrosion-resistant fasteners
Extreme 6 Ply multilayer, reinforced construction for heavy-duty protection
H Wrap custom-fitted high-density polystyrene for optimal coverage

content.text: Learn more about CSS at carmel-corrosion.com

RODOPI is dedicated to advancing renewable energy and industrial services through technology and expertise. Our services include maintaining wind turbines, producing rotor blade components, and installing photovoltaic systems.
We also specialize in corrosion protection work on ships, monopiles, and bridges, utilizing our own blasting and coating hall.

We operate a GWO-certified training center, offering on- and off-site training for professionals. RODOPI values quality and innovation, aiming to provide reliable services and training in the renewable energy and industrial sectors.

RODOPI_Academy_online.title: RODOPI Academy Expands On-Site Training Offering Following GWO Re-Certification
RODOPI_Academy_online.author: Press Release, RODOPI Academy

content.text: RODOPI Blades GmbH is proud to announce the successful re-certification of the RODOPI Academy by the Global Wind Organisation (GWO). This once again confirms our high training standards and our continued commitment to quality and safety in the wind energy sector.

Uwe Jankowski, Training Manager at RODOPI Academy, commented on the renewal of the GWO certificate: “Re-certification by the GWO reaffirms our ongoing pursuit of the highest standards in training and occupational safety. We are proud that RODOPI Academy can train and upskill professionals in line with global guidelines.”

RODOPI Academy offers a comprehensive program of GWO-certified courses, including Basic Safety Training (BST) in First Aid, Manual Handling, Fire Awareness, Working at Heights, and Sea Survival, as well as blade repair training. The offering also includes Basic Technical Training (BTT) with a focus on Mechanics, Electrical, Hydraulics, and Installation. In addition, courses in Enhanced First Aid (EFA) and Advanced Rescue Training (ART) are available.
On-Site Training: Learning Directly at Your Location

To further expand its training capacity, RODOPI Academy now enables the BST First Aid, Manual Handling, Fire Awareness, and Working at Heights courses to be conducted not only at the Academy’s facilities in Xanthi, but also directly on site at the customer’s location. This flexibility ensures teams can be trained right in their working environment, creating a practical and efficient learning setting

“Our goal is to continuously improve employee safety and skills—not only in the wind industry. By offering our courses directly on site, we increase accessibility and convenience for our customers,” Jankowski adds.
For more information about RODOPI Academy and the course portfolio, please visit our website at www.rodopi-academy.com or contact us directly.

RODOPI Academy is a training center specializing in high-quality professional development in the field of renewable energy. With a team of experienced professionals and experts, RODOPI Academy helps train qualified specialists and advance the sustainable development of the energy sector. The training center in Xanthi is certified according to the standards of the Global Wind Organisation (GWO).

We also specialize in corrosion protection work on ships, monopiles, and bridges, utilizing our own blasting and coating hall.

We operate a GWO-certified training center, offering on- and off-site training for professionals. RODOPI values quality and innovation, aiming to provide reliable services and training in the renewable energy and industrial sectors.

jobs.title: Industrial Painter & Corrosion Technician
jobs.textPara1: RODOPI Group, an internationally renowned company based in Düsseldorf, is a trusted service partner for projects involving corrosion protection and surface treatment of wind turbines and steel structures. As a highly specialised provider of personnel services in rotor blade production, RODOPI is at the forefront of innovation in the wind energy sector.
jobs.textPara2: We are not just a provider of high-quality products and services; we also serve as an educational partner, offering specialised training and human resources services tailored specifically to the renewable energy industry.
jobs.textPara3: If you are passionate about renewable energy and excited to join a team that is driving the future of sustainable solutions, we would love to hear from you!
jobs.textPara4: As we continue to grow, we are looking for an Industrial Painter & Corrosion Technician to join our team. This role involves surface preparation, applying protective coatings, and ensuring high-quality corrosion protection for industrial structures. The position is crucial in maintaining durability and longevity in demanding environments.
responsibilities: Scraping, sanding, and cleaning surfaces to remove dirt, grease, and rust
Assessing and inspecting corrosion damage on offshore platforms
Implementing corrosion protection measures such as coatings and insulation
Applying paints or protective coatings using spray guns, rollers, or brushes
Monitoring drying times and colour intensity to ensure work meets specifications
Carrying out regular inspections and maintenance of corrosion protection systems
Identifying and addressing areas requiring reapplication or additional protective measures
Collaborating with other tradespeople to complete projects on time and within budget
Ensuring strict adherence to occupational safety and environmental protection regulations
requirements: Experience with industrial painting techniques (e.g., spray painting, sandblasting)
Valid A1 certificate and EU citizenship
Knowledge of corrosion control methods and protective coatings
Ability to read and interpret technical documents and safety guidelines
Comfortable working at heights, offshore, or in confined spaces
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow procedures
Physical stamina for demanding work environments
Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety
perks: Onboarding program tailored to your position
Participation in task-relevant training
Attractive compensation package
Opportunities to build a sustainable career

jobs.title: Blade Repair Technician (m/f/d)
jobs.textPara1: RODOPI Group, an internationally renowned company based in Düsseldorf, is a trusted service partner for projects involving corrosion protection and surface treatment of wind turbines and steel structures. As a highly specialised provider of personnel services in rotor blade production, RODOPI is at the forefront of innovation in the wind energy sector.
jobs.textPara2: We are not just a provider of high-quality products and services; we also serve as an educational partner, offering specialised training and human resources services tailored specifically to the renewable energy industry.
jobs.textPara3: If you are passionate about renewable energy and excited to join a team that is driving the future of sustainable solutions, we would love to hear from you!
jobs.textPara4: As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Blade Repair Technician to join our team. This role involves surface preparation, applying protective coatings, and ensuring high-quality corrosion protection for industrial structures. The position is crucial in maintaining durability and longevity in demanding environments.
responsibilities: Scraping, sanding, and cleaning surfaces to remove dirt, grease, and rust
Assessing and inspecting corrosion damage on offshore platforms
Implementing corrosion protection measures such as coatings and insulation
Applying paints or protective coatings using spray guns, rollers, or brushes
Monitoring drying times and colour intensity to ensure work meets specifications
Carrying out regular inspections and maintenance of corrosion protection systems
Identifying and addressing areas requiring reapplication or additional protective measures
Collaborating with other tradespeople to complete projects on time and within budget
Ensuring strict adherence to occupational safety and environmental protection regulations
requirements: Experience with industrial painting techniques (e.g., spray painting, sandblasting)
Valid A1 certificate and EU citizenship
Knowledge of corrosion control methods and protective coatings
Ability to read and interpret technical documents and safety guidelines
Comfortable working at heights, offshore, or in confined spaces
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow procedures
Physical stamina for demanding work environments
Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety
